hooks.command:
cpb_project="${PLUGIN_ROOT}"; cpb_environment="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-.venv}"; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s
' 'Character Prompt Builder requires uv to locate its existing environment.' "From $cpb_project, install uv as described in DEPENDENCIES.md, then run: uv sync --locked"; elif cpb_python="$(uv python find --directory "$cpb_project" --offline --no-python-downloads "$cpb_environment" 2>/dev/null)"; then "$cpb_python" -B "$cpb_project/scripts/session_entry_points.py" || printf '%s
' 'Character Prompt Builder session report is unavailable. Check the selected environment using DEPENDENCIES.md.'; else printf '%s
' "Character Prompt Builder environment is not provisioned at $cpb_environment." "From $cpb_project, run: uv sync --locked" 'Retain UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT when it selects another environment. Then rerun the session report with its Python; see DEPENDENCIES.md.'; fi
